profile.headline: Software Engineer at Liberty Mutual Insurance
profile.summary:
Hello! I am a senior (class of 2024) at Boston University studying Computer Science. With my passion for coding, I hope to discover new opportunities in the professional field where I can implement and strengthen my technological skills.

Outside of my academics, I enjoy trying out new restaurants and cooking. If you share the same interests, please feel free to reach out at suinlee@bu.edu

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Leveraged React and JavaScript to efficiently switch out code components, successfully migrating over 20 UI components within the application from Material UI to the Liberty Mutual Design System
• Collaborated with the design and product teams to ensure adherence to company branding and user experience guidelines, resulting in a visually appealing interface for end-users
positions.insights: Skills: Micro ui · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AngularJS

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · HTML

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor
positions.description:
- Taught six children ages 10-15 computer programming in various languages including Scratch, Python, Pygame, and Java. 
- Curated extensive lesson plans multiple times a week that catered towards skill level and learning speed of each individual student, which resulted in an increase of sign-ups for classes.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
- Carried out 500+ daily customer service initiatives and accurately took in multiple customer requests without issues or complaints.
- Provided high quality service by simultaneously maintaining a clean, organized work environment for the team.                                                                                                   
- Oversaw delivery service operations: UberEats, GrubHub

positions.title: Supply Chain Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Executed 20+ comprehensive operational analysis reports for the company’s manufacturing machineries; identified multiple malfunctioning risks associated with the worker’s operation.
- Led team of 3 to audit 200+ tracking devices on factory delivery carts and organized spreadsheets to present how many additional tracking devices were needed to the budget team.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Facilitated city-wide events: Edmonds Waterfront Festival, Taste of Edmonds, Edmonds Art Festival.
Handled lost children incidents and presented full-report briefings of any major events that occurred.

Coordinated with the kitchen staff to deliver food to the patients in the emergency room. 
Offered delivery services for magazines and other forms of entertainment for long-term care patients.

projects.title: Special Olympics Banquet
projects.description: Organized and hosted a celebratory event for the members of the Special Olympics team at Kamiak High School.

organizations.name: Mukilteo Youth Advisory Committee
organizations.description:
Served as a liaison between the youth and the adults in the city of Mukilteo.
Coordinated with the mayor to host the Mukilteo Art Contest and a mental health awareness/suicide
prevention event.
